attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives him as one of three head names on one page — hence three folders. **He is not the corpus's `barbarus-6-may`, and he is not the Barbarus of 15 May either, and both were read before this was drafted.** `barbarus-6-may` is doxologia.ro's bare «Sfântul Mucenic Varvar» of 6 mai, a martyr with no life at all; saint.gr's 15 Μαΐου Barbarus is an Όσιος, the Arab robber of Epirus and Aetolia under Michael II, myrrh-streaming, whom the 05-15 reader drafted as a separate man. This one is a martyr beheaded with two named companions and honoured at the church of Saint Irene by the sea, and the three-name page is what tells him from both. **If a later reading joins any two of these three Barbari, this is the folder to fold, because it is the one with the least in it.** **No year, no country, so no `dates` and no `locations`.** No hymn is printed.
